name: Monkey.D.Luffy
effect:
If you have 6 or more DON!! cards on your field, this Character gains [Rush].
When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker], reveal up to 1 card from the top of your Life cards. This Character gains +1000 power during this turn per 1 cost on the revealed card.

official_faq.question: If the top card of my Life cards is already face-up, can I still use this Character's "When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker]" effect to power up my Character?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. In this case, declare that you are revealing the face-up Life card, and your Character will get +1000 power per 1 cost on the revealed card.

official_faq.question: If my opponent activates the [On Play] effect of their "OP15-046 Sabo", can I use this Character's "When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker]" effect to power up my Character?

My opponent used the [On Play] effect of their "EB03- 031 Vinsmoke Reiju" to activate the [Main] effect of an Event card in their trash. In this case, can I use this Character's "When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker]" effect to power up my Character?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. Activating an Event and using a [Main] effect are considered two different things.

official_faq.question: If my opponent activates an Event's [Trigger] effect, can I use this Character's "When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker]" effect to power up my Character?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. Activating an Event and using a [Trigger] are considered two different things.

official_faq.question: My opponent activated an Event [Trigger] using one of the following effects: "[Trigger] Activate this card's [Main] effect." or "[Trigger] Activate this card's [Counter] effect." In this case, can I use this Character's "When your opponent activates an Event or [Blocker]" effect to power up my Character?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. Activating an Event and using a [Trigger] are considered two different things.
